name: intellectual-property-tech-licensing
description: Structured knowledge graph for EU intellectual property law and technology licensing. Covers EU Trade Mark Regulation (2017/1001), Trade Marks Directive (2015/2436), Copyright in the Digital Single Market (2019/790), Information Society Directive (2001/29/EC), Database Directive (96/9/EC), Trade Secrets Directive (2016/943), Unitary Patent (1257/2012) and UPC Agreement, Supplementary Protection Certificates, Design Directive (98/71/EC) and Community Design Regulation (6/2002), IP Enforcement Directive (2004/48/EC), and Technology Transfer Block Exemption. Includes patentability, trade mark distinctiveness, copyright originality, trade secret protection, SaaS/cloud contracting, open source licensing (GPL, MIT, Apache, copyleft vs permissive), FRAND/SEP licensing, IP due diligence, and AI-generated IP issues.
author: ANTON Legal Team
